data.name: Alien Space Bastards
data.detailed_description:
Survive the Alien Onslaught

The galaxy has become overrun by relentless alien bastards.

Wave after wave of hostile extra terrestrials attack from every direction, filling the battlefield with danger, chaos, and destruction.

Armed only with your piloting skills, quick reflexes, and determination to survive, you'll need to dodge incoming threats, eliminate alien forces, and stay alive for as long as possible.

How long can you withstand the invasion?

Alien Space Bastards is a fast-paced arcade survival shooter that combines intense action, procedural encounters, endless enemy waves, and addictive high-score chasing into one explosive experience.

Every run is a fight for survival.

Every second alive matters.

Every score is a new record waiting to be broken.

Survive Against Impossible Odds

The aliens never stop coming.

Each wave introduces new dangers, increasingly aggressive enemies, and more chaotic encounters that push your skills to the limit.

As the battlefield becomes more crowded and dangerous, survival becomes increasingly difficult.

Stay focused, react quickly, and keep moving.

One mistake could end an otherwise record-breaking run.

No Two Runs Are The Same

Procedurally generated enemy encounters help keep every game fresh.

Different enemy combinations and attack patterns create new challenges each time you play, forcing you to adapt and think on your feet.

No two survival attempts unfold exactly the same way.

Success depends on skill, awareness, and the ability to react under pressure.

Chase Higher Scores

Survival is only part of the challenge.

Push yourself to survive longer, destroy more enemies, and achieve ever-higher scores.

Compete against your previous best performances and see how far your skills can take you.

Every run presents a new opportunity to improve.

Pure Arcade Action

Alien Space Bastards is designed for players who enjoy:

  • Fast-paced arcade shooters

  • Survival-focused gameplay

  • High-score chasing

  • Reflex-based challenges

  • Endless enemy waves

  • Procedurally generated encounters

  • Quick sessions with strong replayability

Easy to learn, challenging to master, and always tempting you to try just one more run.

Features

  • Fast-paced arcade survival shooter gameplay

  • Endless waves of hostile alien enemies

  • Procedurally generated encounters

  • Increasing difficulty as you survive longer

  • Skill-based score chasing

  • Reflex-driven arcade action

  • Online leaderboard competition

  • Highly replayable gameplay

  • Quick to learn, difficult to master

  • Endless opportunities to improve your score

The Invasion Has Begun

The swarm is growing.

The aliens are closing in.

The battlefield becomes more dangerous with every passing moment.

Jump into the fight, survive for as long as you can, and prove you have what it takes to withstand the endless alien assault.

How long will you survive against the Alien Space Bastards?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or Above
  • Processor: x86 or x64 Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidea or Radeon GPU Cards
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Audio
